entities.summary: Ankhkheperure-Merit-Neferkheperure/Waenre/Aten Neferneferuaten, or "Neferneferuaten", is the name of a queen regnant of ancient Egypt who reigned in her own right near the end of the Amarna Period during the Eighteenth Dynasty. Her name features feminine gender traces, and one of her epithets was Akhet-en-hyes. This epithet also features in one version of her nomen cartouche. The name Neferneferuaten translates as either "(“Perfect/Beautiful is the perfection/beauty of Aten”)
